format: html

## Load libraries

```{r}
library(scales)
library(ggplot2)
```

## Variant-dependent Cytokine Expression

### TNF-α Relative Expression

```{r}
dat_unique <- dat_aug %>% 
  distinct(sample_id, variant, log10_tnf_a) 

ggplot(data = dat_unique,
       aes(x = variant,
           y = log10_tnf_a,
           fill = variant)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.85, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.7, size = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(title = "Variant-Dependent TNF-α Expression",
     subtitle = "Relative expression by SARS-CoV-2 variant (log10 scale)",
     y = "TNF-α (Relative Expression)",
     x = "Variant") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_math(10^.x)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none")
```
